new_results: For A=[[B,C],[C^T,D]] with rank C=2, s_j(D|ker C)>=s_{j+4}(A); hence terminal s8 gives four unit exterior directions after killing C.
If B invertible and S=D-C^TB^{-1}C, rank-two perturbation gives s_j(S)>=s_{j+2}(A), so s6(S)>=1 under normalized s8.
Exact fiber factorization phi_Q(t)=int a_t(z)F_t(z)dz with ||F_t||_2<=pi/|t|; hence |phi_Q(t)|<=pi|t|^-1||a_t||_2.
If A_fib^2=int||a_t||_2^2<infinity then ||p_Q||_infinity<=1/pi+A_fib/sqrt(2). If h is the joint density of (CY,R(Y)), this becomes ||p_Q||_infinity<=1/pi+sqrt(pi)||h||_2.

Critical envelope |phi|<=min(1,U/|t|) implies explicit H^sigma, sigma<1/2, and L2 translation-1/2 regularity. For terminal s8 U=6.664084228844336, ||p||_2<=2.059730027165034 and ||tau_h p-p||_2<=7.519613811597714 |h|^1/2 for |h|<=0.3001162547350986.
